sourceReview.excerpt:
##### **Mass: Choose appropriate units of measurement for mass**

- Identify the appropriate unit and device to measure mass

+------------------------------------------------------------------+
|**Example(s):**|
||
|Electronic scales to measure weight of a school bag (kg).|
||
|Kitchen scales to measure weight of ingredients (g).|
+------------------------------------------------------------------+

- Recognise situations where mass would be measured in thousands of
  kilograms or tonnes (t)

+------------------------------------------------------------------+
|**Example(s):**|
||
|Trucks at a weighing station.|
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
